facts.summary: Low-dose cohort showed weak splicing correction versus placebo, no functional gains · Phase 2 · PGN-EDODM1 in myotonic dystrophy type 1 · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Patients (n=6) treated with PGN-EDODM1 at 5 mg/kg demonstrated a mean splicing correction of 7.3%, compared to 6.8% in placebo-treated patients (n=2).
evidence.safety: PGN-EDODM1 was generally well-tolerated, with no serious adverse events (SAEs), all related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs) reported as mild and non-related TEAEs reported as mild or moderate
